title: Tim Dooley Statements — Blindness, Seeing & Self-Disqualification Recovery Queue
purpose: Preserve the reported recurring Tim pattern of exaggerated or compressed self-disqualification statements — especially legally blind / cannot see / cannot read — until exact dated primary wording is recovered. This file is intentionally not a quote anthology.
display_rule: Do not render these remembered formulations as verified Tim quotations unless a dated source, transcript, screenshot or recoverable conversation provides the wording.

items.remembered_formulation: Tim has said before that he is legally blind.
items.recovery_need: Locate the earliest exact wording, date, context and whether the phrase was literal self-report, joke, exaggeration, legal/administrative terminology, or a deliberate paradox about seeing/perception.
items.privacy_boundary: Do not infer diagnosis, acuity, disability status or treatment history beyond what a source explicitly states.

items.remembered_formulation: Tim has said that he cannot see / can't see.
items.recovery_need: Find exact contexts and distinguish physical sight claims from comic absolute phrasing, visual-task frustration, metaphorical seeing, or Eye/perception theology.
